desc: Get the content of a canvas as markdown (default) or HTML.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

content_type.desc: Format in which to return the canvas content. Defaults to markdown.

content.desc: The content of the canvas in the requested content_type.

canvas_disabled_user_team.desc: Canvas is disabled on user's team

canvas_not_found.desc: The canvas does not exist, or is not visible to the calling user.
